profile.headline: Software  Developer at iStream Solution
profile.summary:
•	Experience in Development, Enhancement, Deployment of N-tier Applications with Microsoft .NET Technologies.
•	Experience with Agile methodology.
•	Experience in SOA, MVC, Rest/Web-API, WCF, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, ADO.NET, C#, VB.NET, ASP, PHP, Visual Basic, Design Patterns, SQL and PL/SQL, COBOL/PacBase, Sharepoint/MOSS 2007/WSS.
•	Hands on experience in web technologies such as HTML, AJAX, XML, XSLT, Javascript, JQuery, Angular, Bootstrap for developing web applications. Knowledge of Redis Caching.
•	Hands on experience on using SAP as database and BAPI interface with ASP.NET.
•	Experience on SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL and Access databases. Hands on experience in writing Stored Procedures, Triggers, Functions, Views and SSIS; familiar with SSRS.
•	Experienced in profiling of database using SQL Profiler for removing performance bottlenecks.
•	Hands on experience on implementing payment gateways like PayPal, Google-Checkout, Authorize.NET.

Specialties: C#, VB.NET, MVC, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, WCF, Web-API, SOA, AJAX, JavaScript, HTML, XML, CSS, T-SQL, ASP, PHP, COBOL/PacBase, SharePoint/MOSS 2007/WSS.

projects.title: Modular Meaningful Use Stage 2 Certification for ORB
projects.description: Meaningful Use (MU) Defines the use of electronic health records (HER) and related technology within a healthcare organization.  Achieving meaningful use will also help to determine whether an organization will receive payments from the federal government under either the Medicare EHR Incentive Program or the Medicaid EHR Incentive Program. Stage 2 requirements concentrate on Advanced Clinical Process and Data Sharing.
